searchText: > that is the basis of my assertion that the software is not on the efficient frontier Though OTOH we do need to be careful; adding layers of software complexity to get to the efficient frontier could be bad for future client diversity So if we can make protocol changes to simplify being efficient That would be very valuable Well, my other claim is that you need to take away layers of complexity, not add them, to get to the efficient frontier 🙂 I got people disagree with me on this, but i think I will have a demonstration at some point

> that is the basis of my assertion that the software is not on the efficient frontier

Though OTOH we do need to be careful; adding layers of software complexity to get to the efficient frontier could be bad for future client diversity

excerpts.content: So if we can make protocol changes to simplify being efficient
